Simple Veggie Stew

  • 2 carrots
  • 1 onion
  • 400g canned tomatoes
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  1. Chop the vegetables.
  2. Fry onion in oil.
  3. Add carrot and tomatoes.
  4. Simmer 20 minutes.
  5. Season and serve.
  6. Optional: add herbs.
  7. Rest one minute.
  8. Ladle into bowls.
  9. Garnish.
  10. Eat hot.
